hook_line: MENG REINTRODUCES DIWALI DAY ACT WITH 19 CO-SPONSORS

hook_stat.sub: Co-sponsors for the Diwali Day Act in the House

stats.label: US federal holiday Diwali would become if enacted
Indian-American House members among the co-sponsors

diaspora_bullets: 17 community organisations have endorsed the bill
California observed Diwali with a day off for the first time this year
news_summary: Rep. Grace Meng reintroduced the Diwali Day Act in the House on November 9, proposing to make Diwali a federal holiday.
payoff: The bill must still pass the House and Senate and be signed by the president.
